# FortiGate: aggregate LAN-Bond-10G, island DHCP, pools, VIPs, 90 VLAN interfaces + DHCP (step 1b)
# Generated by plans/gen-fortigate-cli.py from the 13/14 Oct 2026 captures. Do not edit; re-run.
# Lines starting with # are comments for the reader; FortiOS ignores them when pasted.

# STEP 1b: the aggregate, island management scope, pools, VIPs, then all 90 VLAN interfaces
# with their DHCP scopes. Paste in order. Policies are in 41-fgt-policies.txt.

# --- aggregate --------------------------------------------------------------
config system interface
    edit "LAN-Bond-10G"
        set vdom "root"
        set type aggregate
        set member "x1" "x2"
        set lacp-mode active
        set lacp-speed slow
        set algorithm L4
        set ip 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping
        set role lan
        set alias "LAN-10G"
        set description "x1+x2 20G LACP to SW101 SFP1+2; untagged = mgmt VLAN 1 192.168.1.0/24 (replica of ATP500 LAN1); tenant VLANs 10-99 tagged"
        set device-identification enable
        set lldp-transmission enable
    next
end

# --- management VLAN 1 DHCP: replica of the ATP500 LAN_POOL, with the known switches pinned -------
# Switches and APs on the SW01 side keep their 192.168.1.x when their cabinet moves. SW101, SW102 and
# SW14 are set to 192.168.1.101/.102/.114 (gateway .1) in Nebula at the start of the x1 window; the
# reservations below give them the same addresses if they are ever put back on DHCP.
config system dhcp server
    edit 0   # mgmt VLAN 1, copy of ATP500 LAN_POOL
        set interface "LAN-Bond-10G"
        set default-gateway 192.168.1.1
        set netmask 255.255.255.0
        set lease-time 172800
        set dns-service default
        config ip-range
            edit 1
                set start-ip 192.168.1.33
                set end-ip 192.168.1.232
            next
        end
        config reserved-address
            edit 1
                set ip 192.168.1.33
                set mac bc:cf:4f:bb:d8:b3
                set action reserved
                set description "SW12 PH3"
            next
            edit 2
                set ip 192.168.1.34
                set mac bc:cf:4f:bb:e4:7b
                set action reserved
                set description "SW06 FH2"
            next
            edit 3
                set ip 192.168.1.35
                set mac bc:cf:4f:bb:c8:f4
                set action reserved
                set description "SW04 PH2"
            next
            edit 4
                set ip 192.168.1.36
                set mac bc:cf:4f:bb:cb:55
                set action reserved
                set description "SW08 CW3"
            next
            edit 5
                set ip 192.168.1.37
                set mac bc:cf:4f:ce:00:92
                set action reserved
                set description "SW15 Basement"
            next
            edit 6
                set ip 192.168.1.38
                set mac bc:cf:4f:bb:e6:85
                set action reserved
                set description "SW02 main comms"
            next
            edit 7
                set ip 192.168.1.39
                set mac bc:cf:4f:bb:ca:e1
                set action reserved
                set description "SW01 main comms, core"
            next
            edit 8
                set ip 192.168.1.40
                set mac bc:cf:4f:bb:e6:2e
                set action reserved
                set description "SW07 FH2"
            next
            edit 9
                set ip 192.168.1.41
                set mac bc:cf:4f:bb:e3:76
                set action reserved
                set description "SW05 CW2"
            next
            edit 10
                set ip 192.168.1.42
                set mac bc:cf:4f:c4:bc:90
                set action reserved
                set description "SW10 FH3"
            next
            edit 11
                set ip 192.168.1.43
                set mac bc:cf:4f:c4:bf:48
                set action reserved
                set description "SW11 FH3"
            next
            edit 12
                set ip 192.168.1.44
                set mac bc:cf:4f:c4:bb:e2
                set action reserved
                set description "SW09 FH3"
            next
            edit 13
                set ip 192.168.1.45
                set mac bc:cf:4f:bb:c4:a6
                set action reserved
                set description "SW13 PH3"
            next
            edit 14
                set ip 192.168.1.46
                set mac bc:cf:4f:5a:7b:9b
                set action reserved
                set description "FHG2 GS1350 (not in Nebula)"
            next
            edit 15
                set ip 192.168.1.47
                set mac bc:cf:4f:bb:ca:16
                set action reserved
                set description "SW03 PH1"
            next
            edit 16
                set ip 192.168.1.101
                set mac 80:ea:0b:25:b1:d6
                set action reserved
                set description "SW101 (was 192.168.201.2)"
            next
            edit 17
                set ip 192.168.1.102
                set mac 80:ea:0b:25:b1:66
                set action reserved
                set description "SW102 (was 192.168.201.3)"
            next
            edit 18
                set ip 192.168.1.114
                set mac bc:cf:4f:bb:c4:6c
                set action reserved
                set description "SW14 FHG (was 192.168.201.4)"
            next
        end
    next
end

# --- public addressing (decided by Mat 23 Oct 2026). Everyone NATs to the x4 address 193.221.132.138;
# --- only the two tenants who asked get their own: .35 Thames Reach, .36 Cafe OTO. .33 ReLine dead, .34 Mediorite.
config firewall ippool
    edit "POOL-ThamesReach"
        set type overload
        set startip 193.221.131.35
        set endip 193.221.131.35
    next
    edit "POOL-CafeOTO"
        set type overload
        set startip 193.221.131.36
        set endip 193.221.131.36
    next
end

config firewall service custom
    edit "CafeOTO-1000-2000"
        set tcp-portrange 1000-2000
        set udp-portrange 1000-2000
        set comment "Cafe OTO inbound, per James Dunn 23 Oct 2026"
    next
end

config firewall vip
    edit "VIP-193.221.131.35-ThamesReach"
        set type static-nat
        set extip 193.221.131.35
        set mappedip "192.168.54.253"
        set extintf "x4"
        set portforward disable
    next
    edit "VIP-193.221.131.36-CafeOTO"
        set type static-nat
        set extip 193.221.131.36
        set mappedip "192.168.71.1"
        set extintf "x4"
        set portforward disable
    next
end

# --- address objects for the VLANs that get a policy --------------------------------

    edit "LAN-Bond-10G address"
        set type interface-subnet
        set subnet 192.168.1.0 255.255.255.0
        set interface "LAN-Bond-10G"
    next

    edit 0   # vlan10  ATP500 vlan10
        set interface "vlan10"
        set default-gateway 192.168.10.254
        set netmask 255.255.255.0
        set lease-time 172800
        set dns-service default
        config ip-range
            edit 1
                set start-ip 192.168.10.10
                set end-ip 192.168.10.239
            next
        end
    next
